alignment_reasoning: The image fails significant alignment checkpoints: the fish exhibits mottled green/brown coloration and jaw structure characteristic of a Northern Pike (Esox lucius) rather than the silvery, fang-toothed Barracouta (Thyrsites atun). Minor texture smudging on the fish scales and slight lighting disconnects between hands and fish contribute to a moderate artifact score.
